editorial.how_we_test: Recipes are developed and tested in home kitchens before being reviewed by consulting veterinarians for nutritional safety and allergen accuracy.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We earn a commission when you purchase recommended ingredients or kitchen tools through our affiliate links. We also sell digital recipe collections.
editorial.corrections: We update recipes and health guidance as new veterinary insights become available. If you spot an error, please contact us.
